name: Sadness
description: One of the five Primals of the Heart — the ache of loss and of empathy, which deepens connection by reminding a soul what matters. Sadness is not weakness and not despair: doubled it becomes Despair, but laid with Joy it becomes Friendship, with Anger it becomes Justice, and doubled with Joy it becomes Understanding. Those attuned to it slow the world down, share what hurts so that no one carries it alone, and know exactly what everyone in the room has lost.

mastery.title: Primal Harvest
mastery.text: A Primal seal leaves raw emotion behind it, and you are standing right there.

traits.name: Harvest
traits.text: Once per seal, when your Sadness seal damages a creature or a creature fails its save, you may fill one empty Emotion Vessel you carry with Sadness — no Extraction check, no attunement to Emotion required.
traits.card: 1/seal: fill an empty vessel with Sadness, no check

traits.name: Deep Harvest
traits.text: The harvest yields two Sadness instead of one, or, if the creature's dominant feeling is a Complex Emotion built on Sadness, that emotion whole.
traits.card: Harvest 2 Sadness — or the whole Complex Emotion if Sadness is at its root

major.name: Grieving
major.card: Charmed — it cannot bring itself to strike you

offensive.name: The Ache
offensive.description: You give them the weight of everything they have lost, all at once, in the middle of a fight.

tiers.text: The damage becomes cold. A creature hit or that fails has its speed halved until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: Damage becomes Cold · half speed until the end of their next turn

tiers.text: The ache carries to everyone who sees it fall: each other enemy within 15 feet takes a quarter of the damage and loses any temporary hit points and Inspiration.
tiers.card: A quarter to every enemy within 15 ft · their temp HP and Inspiration lost

tiers.text: A creature hit or that fails can't take reactions, and deals one die less damage with its own attacks, until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: No reactions · −1 damage die on their own attacks

tiers.text: Grief. A creature hit or that fails is Incapacitated with grief until the end of its next turn, and for the minute after it can't attack the creature it cares most about — which, briefly, it will remember.
tiers.card: GRIEF — Incapacitated a turn · then it can't attack what it loves

conditions.name: Incapacitated
conditions.duration: until the end of its next turn

supportive.name: Shared Weight
supportive.description: Sorrow's one mercy: it is lighter split between people.

tiers.text: For 1 minute, when the target takes damage, you may take half of it instead as cold damage — and while you share it, the target has advantage on saves against Vile-emotion effects.
tiers.card: 1 min: take half the target's damage yourself as cold · it gains advantage vs Vile effects

tiers.text: The seal's targets are bound to one another: each may use its reaction to grant another advantage on a roll, at any distance, so long as both can be seen by you.
tiers.card: The targets are bound — each may spend a reaction to grant another advantage, at any range

buff.advantage: granted to one another as a reaction

tiers.text: Any damage you take through the bond is halved again, and each bound creature regains hit points equal to Five Times the slot level the first time another of them drops below half.
tiers.card: Shared damage is halved again · 5 × {SLOT} HP when one of them falls below half

tiers.text: Nothing Alone. While the bond lasts, no bound creature can be Frightened, Charmed or made to act against the others, and if one drops to 0 hit points the rest may each spend their reaction to give it hit points equal to Twice your Verum Modifier, bringing it back to its feet.
tiers.card: NOTHING ALONE — no fear, charm or turning on each other · when one falls, the others can each give 2×VM to raise it

control.name: The Long Winter
control.description: Everything slows. Everything is further away than it was.

tiers.text: The area is heavy for 1 minute. A creature that fails has its speed halved and can't take the Dash action while it remains inside.
tiers.card: 1 min: those who fail move at half speed and can't Dash inside

tiers.text: A creature that fails also can't take reactions, and its attacks against anyone but the creature that last wounded it are made at disadvantage.
tiers.card: No reactions · disadvantage attacking anyone but whoever last hurt them

tiers.text: A creature that fails is Charmed by you while it stays inside, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns: it cannot bring itself to strike you, though it will defend itself from others.
tiers.card: Charmed inside (Wis save each turn) — it can't bring itself to strike you

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.escape: Wisdom save at the end of each of its turns

tiers.text: Stillness. For 1 minute the area is silent and slow: no creature inside that failed can take more than one action or bonus action on its turn, healing inside is halved, and any creature that begins two consecutive turns inside is Incapacitated until it leaves.
tiers.card: STILLNESS — one action OR bonus action a turn · healing halved · two turns inside: Incapacitated until they leave

creation.name: Memorial
creation.description: You build the thing that remembers, so the living don't have to carry all of it.

tiers.text: Your creations hold a sorrow you name. Anyone who touches one feels it exactly as you did, and knows it is not theirs.
tiers.card: Creations hold a grief — touch one and feel it, knowing it isn't yours

tiers.text: Your Structures are places of mourning: a creature that spends 10 minutes at one sheds one Vile condition or a level of exhaustion, and nothing hostile to the dead can enter.
tiers.card: 10 minutes at a Structure sheds a Vile condition or exhaustion · the dead's enemies can't enter

tiers.text: An Object you make can carry a grief out of a living creature and hold it instead — the creature remembers what it lost without being crushed by it, for as long as the Object stands.
tiers.card: An Object can take a grief out of someone and hold it for them

tiers.text: A Cairn. One Structure becomes permanent and known: the dead remembered there cannot be raised as undead or bound as Nightmares, and those who mourn there are answered — you may ask the memorial one question about the dead it holds, and it answers truly.
tiers.card: A CAIRN — its dead can't be raised or bound · ask it one true question of them

utility.name: Condolence
utility.description: Knowing what was lost is most of knowing a person.

tiers.text: Know what a creature you can see has lost, and how recently. It knows you know, and takes it as kindness unless it has reason not to.
tiers.card: Know what someone has lost, and when

tiers.text: Ease a grief for 24 hours: the target is not numbed, but can function — no penalties from mourning, and advantage on saves against Vile-emotion effects that use its loss.
tiers.card: Ease a grief for 24 hrs — able to function, warded against what would use it

tiers.text: Stand where something terrible happened and see it: the last hour before a death, a ruin, or a place that mourns, as though you had been there.
tiers.card: See the last hour before a death or a ruin, as if you'd been there

tiers.text: Weep for someone properly: a creature dead no more than a day that is mourned by you can answer three questions, and a soul held by an unfinished sorrow is released by the answering.
tiers.card: Mourn the day-dead for three answers — and release a soul held by unfinished sorrow

complementEffects.name: Heavy Blow
complementEffects.description: The seal lands, and so does everything else they were carrying.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw, the target takes bonus cold damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (min 1d6), and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
effect.card: +1 die cold · −10 ft speed until the end of their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Two dice, and the target loses any temporary hit points and Inspiration.
upgrades.card: +2 dice · temp HP and Inspiration lost

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Three dice, and the target can't take reactions until the start of your next turn.
upgrades.card: +3 dice · no reactions until your next turn

complementEffects.name: Kinship
complementEffects.description: The seal reminds each of them that the others are there.

effect.text: Each of the seal's targets gains temporary hit points equal to your Verum Modifier + the slot level, and while any of them is within 30 feet of another, each has advantage on saves against Frightened and Charmed.
effect.card: The seal's targets: {VM} + {SLOT} temp HP · within 30 ft of each other, advantage vs fear and charm

buff.advantage: saves against Frightened and Charmed while near one another

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Once, one target may take the damage of an attack aimed at another within 30 feet, halved.
upgrades.card: Once: a target takes a hit meant for another, halved

upgrades.text: Level 11+: While within 30 feet of one another, each may use its reaction to grant another advantage on a roll.
upgrades.card: Spend a reaction to give another advantage

complementEffects.name: Sorrow's Drag
complementEffects.description: It is all suddenly very far to walk.

effect.text: A creature hit by or failing the seal has its speed halved and can't take the Dash action until the end of its next turn.
effect.card: Half speed, no Dash until the end of their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: It also can't take reactions while slowed.
Level 11+: If it is already suffering a Vile condition, it is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn instead.
